_comment: iOS Test Suite — JustDial on real device (iPhone 16 Plus).
description: Installs JustDial IPA on real iPhone, launches app, verifies home screen.

desired_capabilities._comment_app: JustDial IPA for real device install
desired_capabilities._comment_noReset: false = fresh install every run (default). Set true via CLI/override to reuse existing app state.
desired_capabilities._comment_autoAcceptAlerts: false = we handle alerts manually via 'dismiss alerts' in flows (deny contacts = no sharing sheet). true = auto-accepts all, grants contacts, triggers JD sharing UI.
desired_capabilities._comment_appPushTimeout: 58MB IPA needs more than default 480s; 900s = 15 min covers large IPAs over slow USB
desired_capabilities._comment_signing: Real device requires WDA code signing. xcodeOrgId + xcodeSigningId are the primary signing config; xcodeConfigFile provides xcconfig overrides.
desired_capabilities._comment_useNewWDA: true = force fresh WDA build and re-sign; set false after first successful run for speed. Bundle ID matches provisioning profiles for team 53NR34M72B.
